programme.title: Crossroads of Cultures: The Legacy of Silk Roads
programme.desc: Quanzhou, situated on the southeastern coast of China, once served as a maritime hub of the East and Southeast Asia trade network during the 10th to 14th centuries, gaining prominence for its exceptional trading port. With 22 distinctive heritage sites listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List, this city stands as a testament to the legendary history of the Silk Roads. In this program, we invite four individuals living in Quanzhou to showcase their daily lives, capturing their journeys through the city's world heritage sites. Through their perspectives, we present a dynamic portrayal of a city rich in heritage. From the maritime splendor of Quanzhou's history to the serene echoes of its ancient city, from the historical treasures of the Luoyang Bridge to the vibrancy of the modern urban landscape, we journey alongside our guests through time and space, exploring Quanzhou's diverse charm and unique allure. Join us as we immerse ourselves in a city that bridges history and cultures, and embraces innovation.

programme.title: Crossroads of Cultures: The Legacy of Silk Roads
programme.desc: Quanzhou, situated on the southeastern coast of China, once served as a maritime hub of the East and Southeast Asia trade network during the 10th to 14th centuries, gaining prominence for its exceptional trading port. With 22 distinctive heritage sites listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List, this city stands as a testament to the legendary history of the Silk Roads. In this program, we invite four individuals living in Quanzhou to showcase their daily lives, capturing their journeys through the city's world heritage sites. Through their perspectives, we present a dynamic portrayal of a city rich in heritage. From the maritime splendor of Quanzhou's history to the serene echoes of its ancient city, from the historical treasures of the Luoyang Bridge to the vibrancy of the modern urban landscape, we journey alongside our guests through time and space, exploring Quanzhou's diverse charm and unique allure. Join us as we immerse ourselves in a city that bridges history and cultures, and embraces innovation.

programme.title: The Elegance of Luoyang
programme.desc: Luoyang, as the eastern starting point of the Silk Road, is a city with a rich history and a tradition of cultural inclusivity. As such, it enjoys a prominent position in the heritage of the whole world. In this episode, we'll visit White Horse Temple to learn about its fascinating international background. At Longmen Grottoes, which were designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in the year 2000, we'll appreciate how the unique ancient splendor is being revived by 3D technology. At the city's annual Peony Festival, we'll explore the significance of China's national flower and national dress. Invited to a Luoyang Water Banquet, we'll learn something about the city's culinary traditions. And finally, a master of tang sancai, or tri-color pottery, will discuss the legacy of this ancient craft and its place in the modern era.

programme.title: The Elegance of Luoyang
programme.desc: Luoyang, as the eastern starting point of the Silk Road, is a city with a rich history and a tradition of cultural inclusivity. As such, it enjoys a prominent position in the heritage of the whole world. In this episode, we'll visit White Horse Temple to learn about its fascinating international background. At Longmen Grottoes, which were designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in the year 2000, we'll appreciate how the unique ancient splendor is being revived by 3D technology. At the city's annual Peony Festival, we'll explore the significance of China's national flower and national dress. Invited to a Luoyang Water Banquet, we'll learn something about the city's culinary traditions. And finally, a master of tang sancai, or tri-color pottery, will discuss the legacy of this ancient craft and its place in the modern era.

programme.desc: Luoyang, as the eastern starting point of the Silk Road, is a city with a rich history and a tradition of cultural inclusivity. As such, it enjoys a prominent position in the heritage of the whole world. In this episode, we'll visit White Horse Temple to learn about its fascinating international background. At Longmen Grottoes, which were designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in the year 2000, we'll appreciate how the unique ancient splendor is being revived by 3D technology. At the city's annual Peony Festival, we'll explore the significance of China's national flower and national dress. Invited to a Luoyang Water Banquet, we'll learn something about the city's culinary traditions. And finally, a master of tang sancai, or tri-color pottery, will discuss the legacy of this ancient craft and its place in the modern era.

As a representative of traditional Chinese silk art, kesi is renowned for its highly ornamental weaving techniques of highlighting warps and breaking wefts, and has been deeply loved by people for thousands of years. In folk culture, it enjoys the reputation of "an inch of kesi is worth an inch of gold."

In folk culture, it enjoys the reputation of "an inch of kesi is worth an inch of gold."

programme.title: China Bound: Chengdu
programme.desc: Tianran spends 3 days in Chengdu, the capital of Sichuan Province and UNESCO's first City of Gastronomy. He dives deep into Chengdu culture, exploring the infamous "mala" numbing and spicy flavors of Sichuanese street food and hotpot, and visiting historical attractions like Wuhou Shrine, Du Fu's Thatched Cottage, and the Jinsha Site Museum, which houses exquisite relics from a 3,000-year-old kingdom uncovered beneath the streets of Chengdu. Of course, no visit to this city is complete without seeing giant pandas and enjoying a cup of tea while getting your ears cleaned in the iconic People's Park. After all, when in Chengdu, do as the locals do.

programme.title: Ding Porcelain Firing
programme.desc: In ancient times, skilled craftsmen combined clay with fire and, using nothing more than their hands and wisdom, created the history of porcelain. A thousand years ago, at the time of the Northern Song Dynasty, a type of porcelain was produced that stood out for its exquisite quality, elegant coloring and beautiful patterns. This was Ding porcelain, and it became a favorite at the imperial court. However, within 200 years, amid the chaos of constant warfare, the art of making it was lost. The dazzling white light of the Ding kilns had faded, seemingly forever. And yet, 800 years later, that light has been reignited.

programme.title: Ding Porcelain Firing
programme.desc: In ancient times, skilled craftsmen combined clay with fire and, using nothing more than their hands and wisdom, created the history of porcelain. A thousand years ago, at the time of the Northern Song Dynasty, a type of porcelain was produced that stood out for its exquisite quality, elegant coloring and beautiful patterns. This was Ding porcelain, and it became a favorite at the imperial court. However, within 200 years, amid the chaos of constant warfare, the art of making it was lost. The dazzling white light of the Ding kilns had faded, seemingly forever. And yet, 800 years later, that light has been reignited.

programme.title: Zero Hour 1
programme.desc: As China sets its sights on achieving carbon neutrality by 2060, young people across the country are looking for creative solutions to help reach that goal. At Tsinghua University, students are learning to become stewards of the planet through research, policymaking, and storytelling. Meanwhile, students in Shenzhen have developed new methods for collecting and using rainwater, innovative grass-planting methods in Inner Mongolia are making China's deserts more habitable, and renewable energy is gradually replacing traditional energy sources. Perhaps the dream of carbon neutrality is closer than we thought.

At Tsinghua University, students are learning to become stewards of the planet through research, policymaking, and storytelling. Meanwhile, students in Shenzhen have developed new methods for collecting and using rainwater, innovative grass-planting methods in Inner Mongolia are making China's deserts more habitable, and renewable energy is gradually replacing traditional energy sources. Perhaps the dream of carbon neutrality is closer than we thought.

programme.title: Cuju
programme.desc: Cuju is the name of a form of football played by the ancient Chinese. It originated in Linzi, capital of the eastern State of Qi around 2000 years ago, eventually evolving into a cultural phenomenon and form of entertainment. The popularity of cuju gradually spread to the areas surrounding Linzi. As a traditional sporting event, it reflects the culture and competitive spirit of the ancient Chinese.

programme.title: Gulangyu Island
programme.desc: Gulangyu Island is famous for its exotic architecture. As a key trade port in the late 19th and early 20th centuries, it was a gathering point for merchants and diplomats from all over the world. This led to a variety of architectural styles being adopted on the island, including a fusion of Chinese and Western designs, as well as some typical of the Chaozhou region. These buildings, mostly over 100 years old, stand witness to China's reconnection with the outside world.

programme.title: Gulangyu Island
programme.desc: Gulangyu Island is famous for its exotic architecture. As a key trade port in the late 19th and early 20th centuries, it was a gathering point for merchants and diplomats from all over the world. This led to a variety of architectural styles being adopted on the island, including a fusion of Chinese and Western designs, as well as some typical of the Chaozhou region. These buildings, mostly over 100 years old, stand witness to China's reconnection with the outside world.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Wing Chun
programme.desc: Martial arts lover Kleber Battaglia is on a mission: To seek out China's kungfu masters, and learn their secrets. From explosive Wing Chun to fluid Taiji Quan, slippery Snake Style to elegant White Crane, he'll learn hidden moves and ancient techniques for defeating powerful opponents. But there's more to kungfu than combat: From culture and philosophy, to wellness and insights from the natural world, Kleber will discover that contained within every kick, strike and throw, is the condensed wisdom of the ancient masters. This is Kungfu-wise. Kleber travels to Foshan, the birthplace of Wing Chun. A practitioner of this style, he seeks out masters of two different lineages: Ip Man and Snake Style. First he visits the Ip Man lineage, based on the legendary kungfu master whose life story spawned hundreds of martial arts movies, with Bruce Lee counting among his students. With Ip Man Wing Chun, Kleber learns how to create powerful short strikes perfectly suited to fighting in Foshan's narrow alleys. With Snake Style, he experiences unique training methods that give its practitioners superhuman flexibility, allowing them to stick to their opponents, and even fight on boats in canals.

programme.title: Colors of the Daliang Mountains
programme.desc: In the first episode of our Sichuan Daliang Mountains series, we journey to Liangshan Yi Autonomous Prefecture in Sichuan Province. Setting off from Xichang, the prefectural capital, we first explore Lizhou Ancient Town, the southern gateway of the Southern Silk Road. We then travel to Huili County in the southernmost part of the Daliang Mountains, where we listen to the morning bells and evening drums, try our hand at making green pottery, and pick fresh pomegranates. Finally, we head to the western part of the Greater Liangshan Mountains and step into the mysterious Lugu Lake. We visit a Mosuo family to learn about their unique culture and take part in one of the Mosuo people's most important rituals: the coming of age ceremony.

programme.title: Foodwise: Datong
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Angela Fu are in historic Datong. Located in northern China's Shanxi Province, some 1500 years ago Datong was the capital of the Northern Wei Dynasty, which saw nomads unite northern China and Buddhism spread throughout the country. At the renowned Yungang Grottoes where giant Buddhas were carved out of cliffs, our hosts discover Datong's multicultural past and sample the emperor's favorite cake. They seek out the remains of a Jesuit church beneath the Great Wall of China, and find in the local cuisine elements that echo the past, and modern-day recipes for thousand-year old dishes.

programme.title: Fujian's Tulou - The Mysterious Earthen Castles
programme.desc: The tulous, or earth-built dwellings, of Fujian are recognized as treasures of traditional architecture, thanks to their unique design, cultural importance, and embodiment of the concept of harmonious coexistence with nature. Tulous are mostly rectangular or circular in form, with a simple, elegant exterior and a well-furnished interior. As homes built by the Hakka people, they are imbued with diligence, wisdom, and the pursuit of excellence. Surrounded by mountains and waters, the tulous blend well with the natural environment. programme.title: Foodwise: Datong
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Angela Fu are in historic Datong. Located in northern China's Shanxi Province, some 1500 years ago Datong was the capital of the Northern Wei Dynasty, which saw nomads unite northern China and Buddhism spread throughout the country. At the renowned Yungang Grottoes where giant Buddhas were carved out of cliffs, our hosts discover Datong's multicultural past and sample the emperor's favorite cake. They seek out the remains of a Jesuit church beneath the Great Wall of China, and find in the local cuisine elements that echo the past, and modern-day recipes for thousand-year old dishes.

programme.title: Foodwise: Datong
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Angela Fu are in historic Datong. Located in northern China's Shanxi Province, some 1500 years ago Datong was the capital of the Northern Wei Dynasty, which saw nomads unite northern China and Buddhism spread throughout the country. At the renowned Yungang Grottoes where giant Buddhas were carved out of cliffs, our hosts discover Datong's multicultural past and sample the emperor's favorite cake. They seek out the remains of a Jesuit church beneath the Great Wall of China, and find in the local cuisine elements that echo the past, and modern-day recipes for thousand-year old dishes.

programme.title: المهرجان الثقافي الدولي الثالث عشر للموسيقى السمفونية - Al Mahrajan Al Thaqafi Al Dowali Al Thaleth A'shr Li Al Moseeqa Al Smphoneyah
programme.desc: ‫‫تشارك فرق أوركسترا سيمفونية بارزة من جميع أنحاء العالم في النسخة الثالثة عشرة من المهرجان الدولي الثقافي للموسيقى السمفونية، حيث تقوم بتأدية الموسيقى الكلاسيكية والأوبرا على خشبة المسرح.‬‬ Prominent orchestras from different countries play classical music on stage during the Festival Culturel International de Musique Symphonique in Algiers.

programme.title: الفارمشيان - EL Pharmacien
programme.desc: ‫‫يحلم شاب تخرج بشهادة جامعية في الصيدلة أن يفتتح صيدليته الخاصة، ولكنه يواجه العديد من المواقف الطريفة بسبب الأوضاع المحيطة في القرية.‬‬ A young man who has graduated with a degree in pharmacy dreams of opening his own pharmacy. However, due to the surrounding circumstances in the village, he comes across various hilarious situations.

programme.title: بغيز ديتي - Brise D'ete
programme.desc: ‫‫يسافر المضيف إلى مناطق الجذب السياحية البارزة في الجزائر لاستكشاف الأماكن التي يمكن للناس زيارتها خلال فصل الصيف.‬‬ The host travels to prominent tourist attractions in Algeria to explore the places people can visit during the summer.

programme.title: لو كونت إست بون - Le Conte Est Bon
programme.desc: ‫‫تدعو المضيفة مجموعة من الأطفال لتحكي لهم قصصا وتثقفهم عن عدد من المواضيع، وتحاورهم في محادثات تساعدهم على تطوير مهارات رائعة.‬‬ The host tells stories to a group of children to educate them on a number of topics while sparking conversations aimed at developing their life skills.

programme.title: نيوز - News
programme.desc: ‫‫يعرض المضيف مجموعة من آخر المستجدات والتطورات المتعلقة بالسياسة والرياضة والأخبار الاجتماعية والاقتصادية.‬‬ The host presents a compilation of the latest updates and developments pertaining to politics, sports, social and economic news.

programme.title: كايين أو ليستوا دن أوفيغ - Cayenne Ou L'histoire d'un enfer
programme.desc: ‫‫يستكشف صانع الفيلم قصة المبعد علي بلحوتس، في المستعمرات العقابية في غيانا، ويكشف عن رحلته وظروفه ومصيره في منطقة الأمازون، القصة المعروفة أيضا بالمقصلة الخضراء.‬‬ The filmmaker explores the story of deportee Ali Belhouts, in Guyana's penal colonies, revealing their journey, conditions and fate in the Amazon, also known as the green guillotine.

programme.title: فخيكونس ميوزيك - Frequence Music
programme.desc: ‫‫‫يؤدي المطرب الشهير أمير نيباش ضمن حفل موسيقي بعضا من أشهر أغانيه ويرفه عن المشاهدين برفقة عدد من الفرق المختلفة.‬‬‬ The famous singer Amir Nebbache hosts a concert where various bands perform their most popular songs for the audience and viewers.

programme.title: كافيه دي آغ - Cafe des Arts
programme.desc: ‫‫يقوم فريق التقديم بدعوة العديد من الفنانين الجزائريين البارزين للحديث عن مجموعة من المواضيع التي تتعلق بالفن، بالإضافة إلى تسليط الضوء على إنجازاتهم وتجاربهم الشخصية ضمن أجواء مرحة.‬‬ The host invites various prominent Algerian artists to talk about an array of art-related topics while highlighting their achievements and personal experiences in a light-hearted atmosphere.

programme.title: فيزيون - Visions
programme.desc: ‫‫تدعو المضيفة شخصيات ومسؤولين وخبراء بارزين من مختلف المجالات، لمناقشة مجموعة من الشؤون التي تهم الشعب الجزائري.‬‬ The host invites prominent personalities, officials and experts from different fields to discuss an array of matters that concern the Algerian people.

programme.title: أنتغي بغيفي "دون لي كولي دو تياتغ ناسيونال ماهيدين بشتاغزي" - Entree Privee Dans Les Coulisses Du Theature National Mahieddine Bacjtarzi
programme.desc: ‫‫تتحدث شخصيات بارزة عن إنجازاتها وما خلف الكواليس في المسرح الوطني الجزائري الذي سمي نسبة إلى محي الدين بشطارزي.‬‬ Prominent personalities talk about their achievements and behind the scenes of the "Théâtre National Algérien Mahieddine Bachtarzi".

programme.title: لي دوسيي دو لا ميمواغ - Les Dossiers De La Memoire
programme.desc: ‫‫من خلال لقطات أرشيفية ومقابلات مع مختلف الشخصيات، يقوم المضيف بتسليط الضوء على يوم استقلال الجزائر وإبراز الأحداث التي أدت إليه.‬‬ Through archive footage and interviews with various politicians and personalities, the host sheds light on the Independence Day of Algeria and the historical events that led to it.

programme.title: بونجوغ دالجيغي - Bonjour D'Algerie
programme.desc: ‫‬ The host discusses various issues and topics concerning the Algerian citizens and tries to provide appropriate solutions to those issues.

programme.title: حياة - Hayat
programme.desc: ‫‫تعاني حياة من معاملة ظالمة من عائلتها، بينما كريم، المصاب بالتوحد، يواجه الاستغلال من قبل إحدى العصابات.‬‬ Hayat suffers from unjust treatment from her family, while Karim, an autistic boy who faces problems, encounters exploitation from a gang.

programme.title: سانتي ماغ - Santé Mag
programme.desc: ‫‫تدعو المضيفة عددا من الأطباء والخبراء في مجال الصحة لتقديم نصائح للمشاهدين لوقايتهم من الأمراض وتحسين نمط حياتهم‎.‬‬ The hostess invites various doctors and experts who offer an array of valuable tips to help people maintain a healthy lifestyle.

programme.title: أفي غوليجو - Avis religieux
programme.desc: ‫‫يدعو المضيف علماء بارزين بمناقشة وإلقاء الضوء على مجموعة من الشؤون والتحديات الدينية، والتي تهم المشاهدين من المسلمين.‬‬ The host invites prominent scholars to shed light on and discuss and array of religious matters and challenges that interest the Muslim viewers.

programme.title: لو جوغنال - Le Journal
programme.desc: ‫‫يلقي فريق التقديم الضوء على آخر وأهم الأخبار والمستجدات والتطورات فيما يتعلق بمجموعة من القضايا في الجزائر والعالم.‬‬ The hosts shed light on the latest and most important news, updates and developments on an array of matters in Algeria and the world.

programme.title: قسمة حب - Qesmet Hub
programme.desc: ‫‫يجبر المعلم المتواضع سليم على الزواج من سارة، لتتمكن من الهروب من سوريا التي مزقتها الحرب والانتقال إلى تركيا.‬‬ Salim, a humble teacher, is forced to marry Sara so that she can escape from the war-torn region of Syria and move to Turkey.

programme.title: بيت جدي - Bayt Jedi
programme.desc: ‫‫تواجه عائلة أبو راشد العديد من الصعوبات الاجتماعية والثقافية أثناء فترة إقامتها في حي الميدان، وذلك خلال فترة الانتداب الفرنسي.‬‬ During the French mandate, Abu Rashed's family faces various cultural and social challenges while living in Al Maidan neighbourhood.

programme.title: إيكو دي زيد - Echos DZ
programme.desc: ‫‫يلقي المضيف الضوء على آخر الأخبار والمستجدات ويغطي أهم القضايا التي تهم الشعب الجزائري، ويحاور عددا من الشخصيات من مختلف المجالات.‬‬ Shedding light on the latest news, which cover the most important issues of concern to the Algerian public and interviews with a number of important personalities from different fields.

programme.title: زهرة النرجس - Zahrat Al Narjes
programme.desc: ‫‫‫في عام ١٩٦٣، تهرب نرجس البالغة من العمر ستة عشر عاما من منزل والدها الواقع في إحدى القرى. مع ذلك، يموت قريبها ويترك لها ميراثا كبيرا.‬‬‬ In 1963, 16-year-old girl Narjes runs away from her father's house in a village, only to end up receiving a large inheritance when her uncle dies.

programme.title: ليه إكسبيغ: سيبيغ - Les experts : Cyber
programme.desc: ‫‫ترأس عالمة النفس الافتراضي أفيري رايان شعبة الجرائم الإلكترونية في بلدة كوانتيكو في ولاية فرجينيا. تستخدم أفيري وفريقها الموارد المتاحة أمامهم للقبض على مجرمي الإنترنت من مبتزين ولصوص ومخترقين.‬‬

programme.title: رحالة دز - Rahalah DZ
programme.desc: ‫‫يزور فريق التقديم العديد من المدن المختلفة حول الجزائر ويقابل شخصيات بارزة منها، وذلك بهدف التعرف على أهميتها الثقافية والتاريخية.‬‬ The host visits various places in Algeria and interviews prominent personalities to shed light on their historical and cultural significance.

programme.title: ذا وندرڤولي ويرد ورلد أوف غومبال:ذا بورينغ - [S01 E09] The Wonderfully Weird World of Gumball:The Boring
programme.desc: يستخدم غامبول وداروين قوة وقف الزمن التي تمتلكها مولي (لأنها مملة للغاية) لتجنب التعرض للضرب بعد المدرسة من قبل تينا. Gumball and Darwin use Molly’s time-halting power (because she’s so boring) to avoid an after school beatdown by Tina.

programme.title: ذا وندرڤولي ويرد ورلد أوف غومبال:ذا تيتشر - [S01 E10] The Wonderfully Weird World of Gumball:The Teacher
programme.desc: يريد غامبول الإطاحة بالسيدة سيميان بعد أن تعاقبه لعدم احترامه الآلة الحاسبة التي قدمتها له المدرسة Gumball wants to take down Miss Simian after she punishes him for not respecting his school-provided calculator.

programme.title: ذا أميزينج وورلد أوف جامبول - عالم غامبول المُدهش:ذا سايكل - [S05 E21] The Amazing World Of Gumball:The Cycle
programme.desc: يكتشف الأطفال أن ريتشارد كان يتعرض للتنمر. The kids find out that Richard has been being picked on.

programme.title: ذا أميزينج وورلد أوف جامبول - عالم غامبول المُدهش:ذا ستارز - [S05 E22] The Amazing World Of Gumball:The Stars
programme.desc: يستخدم غامبول وداروين المراجعات عبر الإنترنت للنقاش حول الأشياء المجانية. Gumball and Darwin use online reviews to wrangle free stuff.

programme.title: ذا أميزينج وورلد أوف جامبول - عالم غامبول المُدهش:ذا بوكس - [S05 E17] The Amazing World Of Gumball:The Box
programme.desc: تظهر حزمة غامضة في منزل واترسون. A mysterious package shows up at the Watterson’s house.

programme.title: ذا إيمايزينغ وورلد أوف غومبول:ذا غرايدز - [S05 E23] The Amazing World of Gumball:The Grades
programme.desc: تعرف على عائلة واترسون: أمي وأبي وأناييس وداروين وبالطبع غامبول، القط البالغ من العمر 12 عامًا والذي يحب المغامرة! Gumball's smart answers aren't the correct ones and he's forced to go back to kindergarten.

programme.title: ذا إيمايزينغ وورلد أوف غومبول:ذا دايت - [S05 E24] The Amazing World of Gumball:The Diet
programme.desc: تعرف على عائلة واترسون: أمي وأبي وأناييس وداروين وبالطبع غامبول، القط البالغ من العمر 12 عامًا والذي يحب المغامرة! Gumball and Darwin discover the real reason Dad's diet wasn't working.

programme.title: ذا إيمايزينغ وورلد أوف غومبول:ذا ويردو - [S05 E29] The Amazing World of Gumball:The Weirdo
programme.desc: تعرف على عائلة واترسون: أمي وأبي وأناييس وداروين وبالطبع غامبول، القط البالغ من العمر 12 عامًا والذي يحب المغامرة! When they see the school bullies making fun of Sussie Gumball and Darwin decide to try and help her act less weird.

programme.title: ذا إيمايزينغ وورلد أوف غومبول:ذا مانيو - [S05 E27] The Amazing World of Gumball:The Menu
programme.desc: تعرف على عائلة واترسون: أمي وأبي وأناييس وداروين وبالطبع غامبول، القط البالغ من العمر 12 عامًا والذي يحب المغامرة! When Richard hears the urban legend of a secret Joyful Burger, he will stop at nothing to devour it.

programme.title: ذا إيمايزينغ وورلد أوف غومبول:ذا أنكل - [S05 E28] The Amazing World of Gumball:The Uncle
programme.desc: تعرف على عائلة واترسون: أمي وأبي وأناييس وداروين وبالطبع غامبول، القط البالغ من العمر 12 عامًا والذي يحب المغامرة! Gumball and Darwin are desperate to meet Ocho's famous uncle.

programme.title: ذا إيمايزينغ وورلد أوف غومبول:ذا هايست - [S05 E30] The Amazing World of Gumball:The Heist
programme.desc: تعرف على عائلة واترسون: أمي وأبي وأناييس وداروين وبالطبع غامبول، القط البالغ من العمر 12 عامًا والذي يحب المغامرة! Richard discovers that going into a bank whilst wearing a motorcycle helmet can land you in a lot of trouble.

programme.title: بن ١٠ سبيشل - Ben 10 Special
programme.desc: ‫‫بفضل جهاز الأومنيتريكس الغامض، يكتسب الشاب بن تينيسون القدرة على التحول إلى أبطال فضائيين أقوياء، ولكن عندما تسعى قوى الظلام للحصول على الجهاز، يستخدمه لإنقاذ العالم.‬‬ With the mysterious Omnitrix, young Ben Tennyson gains the power to transform into powerful alien heroes. However, when dark forces seek the device, he uses it to save the world.

programme.title: وي بير بيرز - We Bare Bears
programme.desc: ‫‫يحاول ثلاثة إخوة من الدببة، وهم غريزلي وباندا وآيس التكيف مع الحياة في منطقة خليج سان فرانسيسكو أثناء محاولتهم التأقلم مع المجتمع البشري الحديث.‬‬ Three brother bears, Grizzly, Panda, and Ice, awkwardly navigate life in the San Francisco Bay Area as they try to fit into modern human society.

programme.title: بن ١٠ - Ben 10
programme.desc: ‫‫يكتشف بن تينيسون ساعة يد تحتوي على أومنيتريكس، بينما يحاول اكتشاف قوتها، يستخدمها لتحويل نفسه إلى أنواع غريبة مختلفة.‬‬ Ben Tennyson discovers a wristwatch which contains the Omnitrix. While he figures out its powers, he uses that to transform himself into various alien species.

programme.title: رول نمبر ٢١ - Roll No 21
programme.desc: ‫‫يجسد كريش اللورد كريشنا، إذ يتم إرساله لحماية أطفال دار الأيتام في ماثورا، حيث يقاتل ضد المدير الشرير كانيشك بطريقته المزعجة التي لا تضاهى.‬‬ Krish, the reincarnation of Lord Krishna, is sent to safeguard the children of Mathura orphanage. There, he fights against the evil principal, Kanishk, in his own mischievous and inimitable way.

programme.title: إيكانز - Ekans

programme.title: بدون سابق إنذار - Bidoun Sabeq Inthar
programme.desc: تتدهور العلاقة بين الزوجين (مروان) و(ليلى) وتصل إلى نفق مسدود بالرغم من محاولتهما لإصلاحها، ولكن تأخذ الأمور منعطفاً صادماً يُشخص ابنهما بسرطان الدم، لتتوالى الأحداث بعدها بشكل درامي كبير. While Marwan and Laila's marriage gets awash with alienation and is beyond repair, a new raging torrent rocks the family when their child is diagnosed with leukemia and what ensues is a crushing blow.

programme.title: قسمة العدل - Qismat Al A'del
programme.desc: يشعل قرار أب بمنح ابنته نصف ثروته صراعًا محتدمًا بين أبنائه، كاشفًا عن خلافات عائلية ومصالح متضاربة حول الميراث. A father’s decision to leave half his fortune to his daughter sparks a fierce rivalry among his children, exposing deep family tensions and conflicting interests over inheritance.

programme.title: العائدون - The Returnees
programme.desc: تدور أحداث المسلسل حول محاولات المخابرات المصرية في التصدي للعمليات والمنظمات الإرهابية، حيث يقوم العاملون بالمخابرات، من ضباط وخبراء اتصال وعملاء سريين، في عمليات تهدف إلى حماية الوطن والقضاء على الإرهاب. programme.desc: يشعل قرار أب بمنح ابنته نصف ثروته صراعًا محتدمًا بين أبنائه، كاشفًا عن خلافات عائلية ومصالح متضاربة حول الميراث. A father’s decision to leave half his fortune to his daughter sparks a fierce rivalry among his children, exposing deep family tensions and conflicting interests over inheritance.

programme.title: الرجل والحصان - A-Rajol Wal-Hisan
programme.desc: عنتر اسم لحصان مميز في أحد مراكز الشرطة بالريف، كان بعهدة (الشاويش طلبة) لسنوات طويلة، فتعلق به وأحبه بما يفوق حبه لأبناءه، وبادله الحصان هذا الحب والوفاء فكان لا يأكل إلا من يده ولا ينام إلا أن ينام صاحبه! ولما شاخ الحصان ولم يكن بقدرة طلبة شراءه لحمايته، امتطاه وهرب به إلى مكان قصيّ. The distinctive horse A'ntar has lived in a police station in the countryside alongside policeman Tolba for many years. When the horse ages and Tolba is not able to afford to save him from death, he mounts the horse and flees to a happily ever after.

programme.title: يتربى في عزو - Yetraba Fi Ezo
programme.desc: يناقش شخصية حمادة عزو رجل متعدد الزيجات شخصية مستهترة بسبب اهتمام والدته الزائد مما يجعله غير قادر على تحمل المسؤولية فيصطدم بواقع الحياة. بطولة يحيى الفخراني ورانيا فريد شوقي. Raised a spoiled brat by his mother, Hamada Ezzo is a reckless man without a single care in the world. But things change when he later struggles to find his way through life.

programme.title: في بيتنا روبوت - Fi Baitina Robot
programme.desc: ينجح الشاب يوسف بصنع نسخ متطورة من الروبوتات، فيقرر مع زوجته الاستعانة بخدماتهم، ويتعرضان معاً للعديد من المواقف الطريفة والمضحكة. Tech genius Yousef is successful at making an advanced version of a robot and decides along with his wife to test out the machine at their home. The funny situations that come along with having a robot at home forms the crux of this comedy series.

programme.title: قيد عائلي - Qaid A'aily
programme.desc: مسلسل درامي مصري تدور أحداثه حول خلاف مرير على الميراث بين عائلتين كبيرتين، ما يؤدي إلى تجاهل صلة الرحم بينهما بباعث جشع المال والثروة. بطولة ميرفت أمين، عزت العلايلي ونخبة من نجوم مصر. Narrates the bitter feud between two families who have a major falling out over inheritance claims, thus sundering old familial bonds.

programme.title: بدون سابق إنذار - [S01] Bidoun Sabeq Inthar
programme.desc: تتدهور العلاقة بين الزوجين (مروان) و(ليلى) وتصل إلى نفق مسدود بالرغم من محاولتهما لإصلاحها، ولكن تأخذ الأمور منعطفاً صادماً يُشخص ابنهما بسرطان الدم، لتتوالى الأحداث بعدها بشكل درامي كبير. programme.desc: تتدهور العلاقة بين الزوجين (مروان) و(ليلى) وتصل إلى نفق مسدود بالرغم من محاولتهما لإصلاحها، ولكن تأخذ الأمور منعطفاً صادماً يُشخص ابنهما بسرطان الدم، لتتوالى الأحداث بعدها بشكل درامي كبير. programme.desc: يشعل قرار أب بمنح ابنته نصف ثروته صراعًا محتدمًا بين أبنائه، كاشفًا عن خلافات عائلية ومصالح متضاربة حول الميراث. programme.desc: ‫‫بعد نجاته لوحده من حادث تحطم طائرة، يصبح الطيار قادرا بشكل غامض على رؤية أرواح الركاب الذين يطلبون منه المساعدة في مهامهم غير المكتملة على الأرض.‬‬ After being the only survivor of a plane crash, the pilot mysteriously becomes able to see the spirits of the passengers who ask him to help them with their unfinished business on Earth.

In Poland, Mike and Elvis find a weathered Polski Fiat 126. After their restoration, they go on a snow-covered joyride alongside other loyal 126 fans.

programme.desc: في ألمانيا، ينشدُّ عقل مايك وإلفيس نحو سيارة بي إم دبليو إي 30 إم 3، لتكون عملية الشراء الأغلى بالنسبة لهما حتى الآن. هل ستجعل جهودهما سيارة إم 3 تتألق كفاية للمشترين؟ In Germany, Mike and Elvis are captivated by an E30 M3, their most expensive purchase yet. Will their efforts make this M3 shine enough for buyers?

programme.desc: يسافر (درو بريتشارد) صائد الكنوز في العصر الحديث عبر البلاد بطولها وعرضها ليبحث عن أشياء غريبة ورائعة، ذات قيمة عالية. Modern day treasure hunter Drew Pritchard travels the length and breadth of the country in search of weird and wonderful objects.

programme.desc: مع الارتفاع الصاروخي في أسعار الذهب، يبذل عمال المناجم جهوداً أكبر من أي وقت مضى للحصول على كميات من الذهب. ومع ذلك، فإن المنافسة ودرجات الحرارة المنخفضة والأرض المتجمدة لن تجعل الأمر سهلاً. With gold prices skyrocketing, the miners push harder than ever to bring home the biggest gold hauls. However, the competition, subfreezing temperatures, and frozen ground will not make it easy.

programme.title: أعمال قذرة:محصول الكافيار / صناعة التوابل - [S10 E04] Dirty Jobs:Caviar Harvester/Spice Maker
programme.desc: يوضح لنا (مايك رو) من أين يأتي طعامنا، ويخرج الكافيار من أسماك نهر المسيسيبي الموحل. فيما بعد، يحضر مايك والديه للعمل معه. Mike Rowe shows us where our food comes from, harvesting caviar from the muddy Mississippi River. Later, Mike brings his parents to work.

programme.title: حمى الذهب:ريك × بَز - [S15] Gold Rush:Rick Vs. Buzz
programme.desc: تحت وطأة الانهيار الاقتصادي، يخاطر ستة رجال بكل شيء للوصول إلى الذهب الخام لاستخراجه وتعدينه في براري ألاسكا. يقود تود هوفمان من (ساندي – أوريغون) ووالده، مجموعة من عمال المناجم الأغرار عديمي الخبرة ويذهبون باحثين عن الحلم الأمريكي وحدود جديدة يتمددون إليها. In the face of an economic meltdown, six men will risk everything to strike it rich mining for gold in the wilds of Alaska. Todd Hoffman of Sandy, Oregon, and his father, will lead a group of greenhorn miners as they go in search of the American dream and a new frontier.

programme.title: حمى الذهب:كنز رجل آخر - [S15] Gold Rush:Another Man's Treasure
programme.desc: يقوم باركر بالتحقيق في قسم منسي من نهر دومينيون، ويقوم ريك بتوسيع طموحاته في وادي ڤيغاس، ويفقد كيڤن حفارة في الوقت الذي ينفد فيه راتبه. Parker investigates a forgotten section of Dominion Creek, Rick expands his ambitions at Vegas Valley, and Kevin loses an excavator just as his pay pile runs out.

Driven by gold fever and sometimes desperate need, miners pilot their ragtag dredges and dive with hoses to suck up gold from the bottom of the frigid, unpredictable Bering Sea.

programme.desc: تكتشف امرأة، بعد أن عانت من ذكريات الاختطاف في طفولتها، زرعاً في جسدها. يشهد البحّار أضواء غريبة فوق المحيط الهادئ. Tormented by childhood memories of abduction, a woman discovers an implant in her body. A sailor witnesses strange lights over the Pacific Ocean.

programme.desc: العصامي ديف كينديغ يمتلك مصنّعه وورشته (كينديغ-إت ديزاين)، المخصصة لتصنيع هياكل وفرش السيارات، يساعده فريقه الماهر ليقوموا كلهم بتجميع وتركيب مركبات يجري تصميمها والتعديل عليها بشكل استثنائي وحسب طلب عملائه المتطلبين، الباحثين عن التميّز. With the help of his skilled team, he turns out exceptionally built and designed vehicles for his demanding clientele.

Mike and Ant take a chance on a 2006 Porsche Cayenne Turbo S. This performance SUV has a lot of horsepower - but potentially daunting repair bills.

Wildlife expert Peter Gros heads to Namibia for a week's assignment at the Cheetah Conservation Fund - an ambitious project aimed at safeguarding the world's fastest sprinter.

programme.desc: هل تساءلت يوماً كيف صُنعت سيارة أحلامك؟ انضم إلى طاقم عمل (كيف تُصنع) لترافقنا إلى مسقط رأسه، لنكشف عن طريقة العمل الداخلية وشكل السيارات الخارجي الرائع. Have you ever wondered how your dream car was made? Join the How It's Made crew as we go to its birthplace, revealing the inner workings and gorgeous exterior.

programme.desc: هل تساءلت يوماً كيف صُنعت سيارة أحلامك؟ انضم إلى طاقم عمل (كيف تُصنع) لترافقنا إلى مسقط رأسه، لنكشف عن طريقة العمل الداخلية وشكل السيارات الخارجي الرائع. Have you ever wondered how your dream car was made? Join the How It's Made crew as we go to its birthplace, revealing the inner workings and gorgeous exterior.
